name: Physical Parameter Optimization
definition: Optimization of physical volume parameters for 3D Gaussians, including extinction coefficient (σ_t), albedo (ω), Henyey-Greenstein scattering asymmetry (g), and multiple scattering octave weights (w).
summary: Physical Parameter Optimization replaces standard 3D Gaussian Splatting attributes with physical quantities like extinction and albedo to solve the radiative transfer equation for real-time dynamic relighting.
